g.text: Thin lines: individual seeds. Thick lines: paired seed means at planned snapshots (x = mean achieved count).
Vertical bars: sample SD (ddof=1), not CI. Horizontal bars: achieved-count range. Cap aliases counted once.
OLD64 uses the historical generator; only B-curve points share the fixed trajectory constraints.
